answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 36345 Country: Canada Title: I want to know is it fardh, wajib, Sunnah, mustahab, makrooh or haram to make dua in "congregation" loudly after the burial of a deceased by standing around the grave facing kiblah. Please provide reference. Question: I want to know is it fardh, wajib, Sunnah, mustahab, makrooh or haram to make dua in "congregation" loudly after the burial of a deceased by standing around the grave facing kiblah. Please provide reference. Answer ID: 36345 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 215/215/M=1433) After the dead is buried it is not only lawful but desirable to make dua for the maghfirah (forgiveness) of a deceased person, firmness in Iman and ease in question. Many hadith assert about it: عن عثمان رضى الله عنه قال كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا فرغ من دفن الميت وقف عليه فقال استغفروا لأخيكم ثم سلموا له بالتثبيت فإنه الأن يسأل (مشكوة شريف 1/ 26 باب اثبات عذاب القبر) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
